items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Black Dot would pick up some of the boys at 8 o'clock in the morning

ctx.x: Yeah, he ran after hours places and J.B. Brown the same thing, and Sonny Howard, I think he had a pool-room --but guys who were in what they called the 'sporting life' you know? They were gamblers and they were hustlers, but it's something about them as far as the black people were concerned, they always seemed to help the youth more than the more educated people.

Now I guess you could say that was because they had it rougher and they knew they wanted to improve -- they didn't want the kids to have the same type of life that they had. That's what I always attributed it to, because I know that I would have to go to a place like Fontana and Black Dot would pick up some of the boys at 8 o'clock in the morning, and he'd been out all night and he would sleep in the car, while we were playing baseball, you know, but the professional people, they didn't seem to do that, so I was…
